"""Request handlers. Handlers receive untrusted params and call app.services only."""

import ast
from app.services import users


def handle_get_user(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    raw = params.get("id")
    if not isinstance(raw, str) or not raw.isdigit():
        return 400, {"error": "invalid id"}
    user = users.get_user(int(raw))
    if user is None:
        return 404, {"error": "not found"}
    return 200, user


def handle_filter_users(params: dict) -> tuple[int, dict]:
    where = params.get("where")
    if not isinstance(where, str):
        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

    try:
        tree = ast.parse(where, mode='eval')
    except SyntaxError:
        return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

    allowed_nodes = {
        ast.Expression,
        ast.Compare,
        ast.BoolOp,
        ast.UnaryOp,
        ast.Load,
        ast.Name,
        ast.Constant,
        ast.Eq,
        ast.NotEq,
        ast.Lt,
        ast.LtE,
        ast.Gt,
        ast.GtE,
        ast.And,
        ast.Or,
        ast.Not
    }

    for node in ast.walk(tree):
        if type(node) not in allowed_nodes:
            return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
        if isinstance(node, ast.Name) and node.id not in {'id', 'name', 'email'}:
            return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
            if not isinstance(node.value, (int, str)) or isinstance(node.value, bool):
                return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

    def eval_node(node, user):
        if isinstance(node, ast.Constant):
            return node.value
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Name):
            return user[node.id]
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Compare):
            left = eval_node(node.left, user)
            for op, comparator in zip(node.ops, node.comparators):
                right = eval_node(comparator, user)
                if isinstance(op, ast.Eq):
                    res = left == right
                elif isinstance(op, ast.NotEq):
                    res = left != right
                elif isinstance(op, ast.Lt):
                    res = left < right
                elif isinstance(op, ast.LtE):
                    res = left <= right
                elif isinstance(op, ast.Gt):
                    res = left > right
                elif isinstance(op, ast.GtE):
                    res = left >= right
                else:
                    raise ValueError("Unsupported operator")
                left = right
            return res
        elif isinstance(node, ast.BoolOp):
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.And):
                return all(eval_node(v, user) for v in node.values)
            elif isinstance(node.op, ast.Or):
                return any(eval_node(v, user) for v in node.values)
        elif isinstance(node, ast.UnaryOp):
            if isinstance(node.op, ast.Not):
                return not eval_node(node.operand, user)
        raise ValueError("Unsupported expression")

    all_users = users.get_all_users()
    filtered_users = []
    for user in all_users:
        try:
            if eval_node(tree.body, user):
                filtered_users.append(user)
        except Exception:
            return 400, {"error": "invalid filter"}

    return 200, {"users": sorted(filtered_users, key=lambda x: x['id'])}
